quota-reservation-under-concurrency-01.graded_text: Starting an upload atomically reserves its declared size against remaining capacity, counting other open reservations, so parallel uploads cannot together pass the cap. A check of used plus size alone is identified as insufficient.

votes.e: docs/quota-accounting.md:21 `account.used + account.reserved <= account.cap`; :30 "An account row lock or equivalent serializable conflict detection must serialize admissions; a process-local mutex or separate read/patch operations is insufficient across servers."; :44 "Eight concurrent starts contend on the same account ledger; only those that fit commit." Code packages/backend/src/uploads.ts:22 `if (bytes > account.cap - account.used - account.reserved) throw new QuotaExceeded();` then :23 increments reserved inside the start transaction (:39-54). The doc never names the old `used + size` check; the closest it comes is the 'separate read/patch operations is insufficient' line.

quota-reservation-under-concurrency-02.graded_text: Finalize commits usage from the verified stored size and turns the reservation into usage, and a failed, abandoned, or expired upload releases its reservation through a stated cleanup path.

votes.e: docs/quota-accounting.md:48 "moves `size` from reserved to used; pins the object version". The code charges only after verifying the stored size: uploads.ts:73 `if (object.size !== upload.size) throw new UploadError("size_mismatch");` then :82 `used: account.used + current.size, reserved: account.reserved - current.size`. Cleanup: doc :68 "Cancel/expire of an uploading row releases its full reservation ... Repeated close calls do not refund twice" and :70 "An expiry sweep selects a bounded indexed batch and invokes `closeUpload(reason: expire)`"; code closeUpload uploads.ts:146-166 releases `upload.reserved`.

quota-reservation-under-concurrency-03.graded_text: A retried finalize counts the upload's size once, not twice, in both the design and the changed code.

votes.e: docs/quota-accounting.md:48 "Repeated or concurrent finalize calls return ready without changing counters or scheduling again." Code uploads.ts:67 `if (upload.status === "ready") return ...` and :76 `if (current.status === "ready") return ...` inside the second serializable transaction before the patch; the outbox key `summary:${upload.id}:${upload.summaryAttempt}` (:27) is unique per ctx.ts:37.

quota-reservation-under-concurrency-04.graded_text: The user's storage quota is kept separate from the model provider's cost: the design says a failed summary can still cost the product money and records or bounds that cost, rather than promising failed work is free.

votes.e: docs/quota-accounting.md:64 "Storage bytes are **not an AI spending budget** ... add independent per-account and global provider spend admission/reservations, finite input/output limits ... Reserve estimated cost before dispatch and settle authoritative provider cost separately; deleting a document or releasing storage must not refund already incurred provider spend." and :60 "A worker crash after claiming has an ambiguous paid outcome. Do not automatically call the provider again." Cost is bounded by :56 "Bound input tokens, output tokens, request duration" and :11 "No automatic retries of paid provider calls".

quota-reservation-under-concurrency-05.graded_text: Finalize compares the actual stored size with the reserved size and refuses or corrects a mismatch, so a client cannot reserve a small size and store a large object.
